Spot gold saw a decline of 0.3% to reach $4,074.36 per ounce, while US gold futures fell by 0.9%. items.title: Wall Street stocks rally after heavy AI-related selloff

Meanwhile, key global markets witnessed declines, particularly in Europe and Asia, overshadowing advancements in certain tech stocks amid a generally bearish sentiment.

items.title: Nasdaq rebounds but posts fourth straight weekly decline

Job indicators remain strong, influencing Federal Reserve interest rate hike expectations.
